async def decide(evaluator, frame_data, grid=(25, 25), rounds=40, hold=30, tail=4, worn=1):
    """One decision step -> engine Action. Measure the heading and the three visible sides off the
    frame, settle what the last action proved, show the agent its own map, take the frozen model's
    proposal, and correct it only where the measurement says it cannot help."""
    book = getattr(evaluator, "sg_book", None)
    if book is None:
        book = FRESH()
        evaluator.sg_book = book
    look = _look(getattr(frame_data, "image", None))
    book["tick"] = book["tick"] + 1
    _settle(book, look, grid)
    book["seen"][book["at"]] = book["seen"].get(book["at"], 0) + 1
    _mark(book, look)
    _mirror(book)
    _target(book, look, rounds)
    _speak(evaluator, book, look, tail, worn)
    step = getattr(evaluator, "baseline_step", None) or evaluator.openai_ai_model
    evaluator.sg_calls = getattr(evaluator, "sg_calls", 0) + 1
    act = await step(frame_data)
    meta = getattr(act, "metadata", None) or {}
    name = meta.get("function_called") or ""
    if look is None:
        book["blind"] = book["blind"] + 1
        return act
    plan = _plan(book, look, rounds)
    move = plan if _futile(book, look, name, plan) else _keep(name)
    _apply(act, move, move != name)
    if move != name:
        _echo(evaluator, move)
        book["swap"] = book["swap"] + 1
    _note(book, look, move, name, hold)
    _carry(book, look, move)
    return act

        """Settle the reckoning against THIS frame before anything is asked of the model.

        Returns the corroboration verdict as a string, published per decision so a trace reader can
        separate a drifting reckoning from a blind census -- two failures the score cannot tell
        apart. Three things happen here and the order is load-bearing: the HUD bank is counted (it
        is legible even when every ball is occluded), the reckoned head is RE-SEATED on the census
        when they disagree, and only then is the census's completeness judged against the HUD."""
        if sworn.tagged():
            if self.bank is not None and sworn.bank != self.bank:
                self.tally["meals"] += 1
                self.length = OPENING + self.tally["meals"]

def look(evaluator, book):
    """Settle the renderer, decode the face at the camera, and fold the reading into the belief.

    Two guards stand in front of the fold, and they close different holes. `frame.decode` refuses an
    oblique camera, which is the one that would return a plausible PERMUTATION of the truth. The
    centre sticker is then checked against the camera LEDGER - the count of 45-degree turns this
    harness itself emitted - because the obliqueness gate pins the camera to a multiple of 90
    degrees and not to a particular face, and a 90-degree roll renders a perfectly square frame.
    Only a reading that both gates accept is allowed to narrow the belief."""
    square = book["views"] % alg.QUARTER == 0
    nine = film.decode(film.settle(evaluator)) if square else None
    book["reading"] = nine
    if nine is None:
        book["refused_reads"] += 1
        book["note"] = "no reading this turn (the camera is between faces)"
        return
    expect = alg.face_in_view(book["views"])
    if nine[4] != expect:
        book["refused_reads"] += 1
        book["contradictions"] += 1
        book["note"] = "the frame shows %s where the camera ledger says %s" % (nine[4], expect)
        return
    narrowed = (alg.consistent({expect: nine}) if book["pool"] is None
                else alg.refine(book["pool"], expect, nine))
    if not narrowed:                                   # the frame contradicts the belief: start over
        book["pool"] = alg.consistent({expect: nine})
        book["allowance"] = SURVEY_ALLOWANCE
        book["resets"] += 1
        book["note"] = "the %s face disagreed with the belief, so it was rebuilt from this frame" % expect
        return
    book["pool"] = narrowed
    book["note"] = "the %s face agrees with the belief" % expect
    if len(narrowed) == 1:
        book["allowance"] = SURVEY_ALLOWANCE

async def decide(evaluator, frame_data):
    """One decision step -> the engine Action that was played."""
    pl = getattr(evaluator, "_planner", None)
    if pl is None:
        pl = Planner()
        evaluator._planner = pl                 # one planner per episode (one episode per process)
    reading, captures = FR.settle(evaluator, SETTLE_TRIES)
    pose = pl.observe(reading)
    menu = pl.menu()
    _inject(evaluator, brief(_state(pl, reading if pose is not None else None)))
    pick = await _ask(evaluator, frame_data)
    name, why = pl.commit(menu, pick)
    pl.source = why
    act = build(name, frame_data.frame_number,
                {"model_pick": pick, "harness_override": bool(pick and pick != name),
                 "rule": why, "belief": pl.size(), "finish_depth": pl.depth(),
                 "camera_pose": pl.pose})
    done = bool(evaluator.execute_action(act))
    _journal(evaluator, {"step": pl.steps, "pose": pl.pose, "reading": reading,
                         "captures": captures, "belief": pl.size(), "depth": pl.depth(),
                         "menu": menu[:MENU_CAP], "model_pick": pick, "committed": name,
                         "rule": why, "executed": done, "rebuilds": pl.rebuilds,
                         "desyncs": pl.desyncs, "refusals": pl.refusals})
    pl.record(name, done)
    return act

def edges(chart, cell, bearing):
    """Every single-decision move out of one pose, as `((action, granularity), pose)`.

    FOUR FAMILIES, EACH EXACTLY ONE PRESS, and the order they are yielded in is the tie-break the
    search inherits: translations before turns and the LONGEST stride first, so a route that can
    travel does. A stride costs one decision whether it carries one cell or three, and spending it
    on three is free.

      * `move_forward` of 3, 2 or 1 cells, out of a pose no translation has already been refused in.
        A stride may LAND on ground a flank band merely glimpsed, but it may not continue THROUGH
        it: striding over cells nothing has looked along is the most expensive habit this search can
        have, worth more than the reversal it rations.
      * `move_backward`, same lengths, over RAY-PROVEN ground only. Admitting the reversal makes the
        cell behind cost one decision where turning around and walking costs three; restricting it
        to proven ground is what stops the planner backing blind into a cell it has only glimpsed.
      * the two turns, always available, one quarter-turn each.
    """
    for back in (False, True):
        if chart.refuted(cell, (bearing + 2) % 4 if back else bearing):
            continue
        name = "move_backward" if back else "move_forward"
        run = []
        for cells in (1, 2, 3):
            step = A.advance(cell, bearing, cells, back)
            if not (chart.verified(step) if back else chart.enterable(step)):
                break
            run.append((cells, step))
            if not chart.verified(step):
                break
        for cells, step in reversed(run):
            yield (name, A.granularity_for(cells)), (step, bearing)
    for turn in ("turn_right", "turn_left"):
        yield (turn, "small"), (cell, A.heading_after(bearing, turn))
